comment: Default Jira Issue Template definition deployed by platform/scripts/deploy_jira_issue_template.py (platform-mimari-foundation task 12.2, requirement 10.2). The template aligns the target Jira site with a canonical 'AI Bot Task' shape: one issue type, three custom fields, and a screen-scheme association. Re-running the script with this same definition is a no-op.

issue_type.name: AI Bot Task
issue_type.description: Issue template optimised for AI bot consumption. The description body is the PRIMARY contract — see prompts/task_creation_assistant.md for the YAML frontmatter syntax (workflow_type, repo, branch, cleanup, output, web_search, timeout_seconds, needs_ssh, needs_docker). The three custom fields below (AI Bot Repo / Branch / Cleanup) are convenience shortcuts that mirror the most common frontmatter keys; everything else (workflow_type, output destinations, Confluence space, language, etc.) goes inside the YAML block at the top of the description.

fields.name: AI Bot Repo
fields.description: Source repository slug consumed by the AI bot.

fields.name: AI Bot Branch
fields.description: Target branch the AI bot operates against.

fields.name: AI Bot Cleanup
fields.description: Whether the AI bot should delete its working branch after merge.

screen_scheme.name: AI Bot Task Screen Scheme
screen_scheme.description: Screen scheme bound to the AI Bot Task issue type.
